posts.text: Q1 FY27 Results and Notes from Concall: Business momentum remained strong this quarter The loan book crossed ₹3 lakh crore , growing 20% YoY . The Retail, Agri, and MSME portfolio grew 18% YoY . The Wholesale loan book grew 30% YoY . 90% of the MFI book is now covered. The credit card loan book grew over 19% YoY , while card spends increased 21% YoY . Wealth Management AUM grew 24% YoY to ₹64,000 crore . posts.text: image 1091×795 111 KB Q1 FY27 provisional numbers are here. Deposits grew by 5.9% QoQ (26% annualized). CASA grew by 8.1% QoQ (36.5% annualized). There were fears that IDFC bank will find it hard to raise deposits post the recent fraud incident. Well, those fears have been dispelled by these strong numbers.
